title: The Last Memory of Fire (Weyland Industries Mix)

texts:
_With so much gratitude to Its Rated Merc who created that fanvid using different cuts from the Alien franchise._

## San Jaya Prime - The Last Memory of Fire (Weyland Industries Mix)

When Peter Weyland stepped up on the stage at a mock Ted Talk, something shifted. I started pulling bits and pieces from the title track off of my EP, "[The Last Memory of Laughter](other-original-music)". I sampled in Weyland's words, cleaning and amplifying them throughout the music. With BMFD on the final master, it was just days before I had a production cut.

It's up [here on SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/jaya-prime/weyland-industries) for listening, with the original release back in 2012 on April 26.

As it turns out, that was just the beginning. While the original cut has racked up tens of thousands of plays across SoundCloud, YouTube ([link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n7KE33V3ExU)), and BandCamp ([link](https://sanjayaprime.bandcamp.com/track/the-last-memory-of-fire-the-weyland-industries-mix)) -- where it's still up for free download, btdubz -- it really took off when we started playing it live... first with Mad Maxine, then later with Dez. We've changed it up over the years, but the last two times -- the first at Lakes of Fire, the second in the ruins of Fort Laud -- those were easily our best ever. I've been cleaning recordings from those shows. Between the two of them, I think I've got a live cut that's ready for release.

You'll find that live cut on the "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)" album.

"We are now three months into the Year of Our Lord 2023. At this moment in our civilization, we can create cybernetic individuals--who, in just a few short years, will be completely indistinguishable from us--which leads to an obvious conclusion: We are the gods now."

Full transcript taken from the Prometheus TED Talk with Peter Weyland ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0EVFrSuyA-c)):

_<font face="Times New Roman">Fire was a gift from the titan Prometheus, a gift that he stole from the gods! And Prometheus was caught and brought to justice for his theft. The gods... well, you might say they overreacted. The poor man was tied to a rock, as an eagle ripped thru his belly and ate his liver, over and over, day after day. All because he gave us fire, our first true piece of technology. Fire.</font>_

_<font face="Times New Roman">100,000 B.C.: Stone tools. 4,000 B.C.: The wheel. 9th century A.D.: Gunpowder. 19th century: Eureka! The light bulb! 20th century: The automobile, television, nuclear weapons, spacecraft, Internet. 21st century: Biotech, nanotech, fusion and fission, and M-theory. And THAT was just the first decade!</font>_

_<font face="Times New Roman">We are now three months into the Year of Our Lord 2023. At this moment in our civilization, we can create cybernetic individuals--who, in just a few short years, will be completely indistinguishable from us--which leads to an obvious conclusion: We are the gods now.</font>_

_<font face="Times New Roman">For those of you who know me, you will be aware by now that my ambition is unlimited. You know that I will settle for nothing short of greatness or I will die trying. For those of you who do not yet know me, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Peter Weyland, and if you'd indulge me, I'd like to change the world.</font>_

## Extended Exploration

For those who like "The Last Memory of Fire", check out my EP "[The Last Memory of Laughter](other-original-music)", especially the title track. You might also like my remix of "[TH3 GR1D](daft-punk-the-grid-remix)" by Daft Punk. Then of course don't miss the live version on "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)" or my book "[Memoriam Redacta](memoriam-redacta)" that dives more into the science fiction side of it.. . with that word "fiction" quickly becoming "reality" instead.
